items.title: Pay invoice for built-in shelf
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug auf unser Konto (IBAN siehe unten).
items.computation: Trigger event is the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) 30.01.2026 (a Friday). Under §187(1) BGB, since the period runs 'nach' (after) the event, counting starts the following day: 31.01.2026. Under §188(2) BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the last month numerically corresponding to the day of the triggering event, i.e. the 30th, which would be 30.02.2026. February 2026 has only 28 days (2026 is not a leap year), so under §188(3) BGB the period ends on the last day of February: 28.02.2026. That day is a Saturday. §193 BGB extends deadlines falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday to the next business day. 01.03.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 02.03.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW.
